stock.description: Established in 2012 and headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China, Zhongguancun Science-Tech Leasing Co., Ltd. provides financial leasing and lease-backed equity investment services. These offerings are specifically designed for innovative science and technology enterprises operating within mainland China. The company is a subsidiary of Zhongguancun Development Group Co., Ltd.
